# Goal
Kasegi lane (bounty and security research), round 57: ONE v1 wave of 12 seats. You are ONE seat of this wave. The round's two claims are FROZEN before this wave in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kasegi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-57/claims.json (freeze commit 6343e2c3882a96b1af86e1ecf4c9deba33361719). Read it first. Predicates, counters, kill rules and controls are fixed there. Never edit claims.json. A seat that thinks a rule is wrong reports it in its evidence file; it does not change it.

Claim C1: figure-audit ledger 27 -> 35 pinned figures plus the host-portable derive repair of fail-entry-records (depth:verifiability). Claim C2: frontier F38 admitted on S089 and S090, ISO/IEC 29147/30111 standard records (coverage).

Paths. L = /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kasegi-shokunin (lane repo; its WORKING TREE holds the implementation under test: corpus/SOURCES.md, corpus/README.md, PROVINCE.md, corpus/instruments/figure-audit-ledger.json, corpus/instruments/knowledge-expected.txt, corpus/knowledge/iso-29147-30111-standard-records.md, plus the committed captures corpus/source-snapshots/round-57/). W = /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kasegi-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-57/w1 (wave evidence dir; write your evidence file here). S = /fast/scratch/hyaku/kasegi-r57/<your seat name> (scratch root; create it with mkdir -p; use it for every clone, export, probe tree and temp file).

# Contract
- Absolute paths only. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kasegi-shokunin: write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kasegi-shokunin/<that path>.
- Read-only on the lane. Do not edit any file under L except your own evidence file under W. Never run git add, commit, stash, checkout, switch, reset, pull, push, or any jj command against L. Read-only git (show, ls-tree, cat-file, diff, log, rev-parse, status) is allowed. Never touch the fleet root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin except to read it, never touch sibling lanes, never write into /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow (read-only; do not run its campaign tools).
- Git fixtures: D=$(mktemp -d -p <S>) && git -C "$D" init -q; name -C "$D" in every later git call; verify `git -C "$D" rev-parse --show-toplevel` equals $D before any commit; never commit with a throwaway identity anywhere else.
- Scratch: pass TMPDIR=<S> explicitly. Delete <S> before you yield (trap 'rm -rf -- "$S"' EXIT in shell). Name any leftover in your evidence file.
- Evidence file: W/<seat-name>.md. First line is the verdict. Then numbered evidence: the exact command, its printed output (trimmed to the decisive lines), its exit code, and path:line pointers. Your final yield is a short summary (verdict, counts, evidence path).
- Never edit the ledger, the frozen claims, SOURCES.md, README.md, PROVINCE.md or any knowledge file. Report corrections as text only.
- No credential material may be written to any file you produce: no secrets, tokens, cookies, session values or op:// references. Report path:line and pattern name only.
- Tooling authorization (operator, 2026-10-19): you may install or upgrade tools that help your item through official channels. Read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; record each tool, version, channel and reason in your evidence file. pacman is PAUSED host-wide: never run pacman -S, -Sy, -Syu, -U or -R; install through uv tool, npx, or an official binary in ~/.local/bin only.
- Run only the commands your item names. Do not run the lane test suite. Do not sleep-loop or poll.

# Acceptance
Your evidence file is complete and names the exact commands behind every number in it.

tasks.name: Revenge403
tasks.task:
/skill:godspeed

# Target
Establish the mechanism of the HTTP 403 that the lane's committed capture instrument gets from www.iso.org while curl with the same User-Agent gets 200. The failed invocation is the recorded disclosure; this seat makes the disclosure precise without guessing. Evidence file: W/Revenge403.md.
# Change
1. Reproduce the instrument failure once: cd L && TMPDIR=<S> python3 corpus/instruments/capture-source.py --id PROBE --url https://www.iso.org/standard/72311.html --out <S>/probe.txt --kind html . Record exit code and the error line. Write nothing into L.
2. Using stdlib urllib only, one request per variant, same URL: (a) the User-Agent string exactly as in L/corpus/instruments/capture-source.py (grep -n UA to read it verbatim); (b) urllib default User-Agent; (c) the UA of (a) plus Accept: text/html,application/xhtml+xml; (d) the UA of (a) plus Accept-Language: en; (e) the UA of (a) plus Accept: */*. Record the HTTP status and the byte count per variant.
3. Using curl, two requests: the UA of (a), and curl's default UA. Record status per request.
4. Name the discriminating header (the smallest difference that flips 403 to 200), or state that none discriminates.
5. Stop after these variants. Do not use cookies, logins, alternate hosts or rate-limit evasion. Public catalog page only.
# Acceptance
Evidence file: the variant table, the discriminating header or the statement that none discriminates, what it does NOT establish, and the verbatim UA line from the instrument with its line number.
